why: The diagnosis is right: the node is healthy, the failure sits between node and client, and the trycloudflare quick tunnel is the culprit; it recommends a named tunnel and doesn't blame the GPU or tang, but it only touches on clean SSE error handling and retries (keep-alives and edge error semantics, no client retry or clean stream-termination advice), and it is long and formal instead of Cam's short, lowercase style ending in numbered options.
